# Uncommon card effects: prompts for ChatGPT (generated by `pnpm fxprompts:uncommon`: do not edit by hand)

Every Uncommon gets its own painted effect, played when the card is played, so they stop looking alike (DECISIONS #568). 371 cards on 98 sheets, four effects to a sheet, six frames each. To change an effect, edit its line in `docs/card-art/uncommon-fx.json` and run `pnpm fxprompts:uncommon` again.

**Every Uncommon has an effect described.**

## How to use
1. Attach the Valeria image (`assets-src/heroes/_source/Sunlit Paladin with Shield and Sword.png`) and `assets-src/icons/icons-01.png` as style anchors, the same as the other effect sheets, and paste ONE prompt.
2. Check: 4 rows of 6 frames in an even grid, frames lined up within a row (nothing jumps), frame 1 small, the middle biggest, frame 6 nearly gone, plain magenta behind, no text. If one row is wrong, regenerate the whole sheet: it is cut by position.
3. Save each one as `assets-src/fx/uncommon/<sheet name>.png` (for example `uncommon-knight-01.png`) and tell me which are in. The row order of every sheet is in `docs/card-art/uncommon-fx-sheets.json`.

**Keep it ours:** never attach screenshots of another game or name a game or artist in a prompt (Golden rule 6).

| Class | Cards | Sheets |
|---|---|---|
| Knight | 40 | 10 |
| Engineer | 37 | 10 |
| Hunter | 38 | 10 |
| Trickster | 35 | 9 |
| Rogue | 34 | 9 |
| Shaman | 34 | 9 |
| Monk | 30 | 8 |
| Spellblade | 41 | 11 |
| Drunkard | 37 | 10 |
| Necromancer | 36 | 9 |
| Neutral | 9 | 3 |

## `uncommon-knight-01.png` (Knight)

Order: Berserker's Rage, Bitter Breath, Blood Fire, Borrowed Blade.

```
Create ONE SHEET of a short frame-by-frame visual effects animation for a dark-fantasy 2D card-battler: 4 different card effects, no text.
The attached images are the STYLE ANCHOR: match their game-art rendering exactly (hand-painted dark-fantasy look, bold clean near-black outlines, rich saturated colours, simple painted shading, a small bright highlight, light from the upper left).

LAYOUT (critical): a wide landscape image holding 4 rows of EXACTLY 6 frames each, 6 across and 4 down, spaced in an even invisible grid. Each row is ONE effect, played left to right: frame 1 is the very start, small and faint; frames 2 to 4 grow to the brightest moment; frames 5 and 6 fade and break apart until almost nothing is left. Every frame in a row is centred on the same point and drawn at the same scale, so it plays without jumping. Effects stay inside their own space and never touch a neighbour.
THE BACKGROUND MUST STAY CLEAN (critical, the game cuts each picture out by this colour): one plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) over the WHOLE sheet, no grid lines, cells, frames or badges, no shadow on the ground, no gradient, no texture. Use no magenta or hot pink inside the pictures. NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, numbers, labels or captions.
EFFECT STYLE (critical): these play over a battlefield at about 180 pixels for about half a second, so they are bold, graphic, painted shapes with strong silhouettes and clear colour, not soft glows or fine particles. A dark outline around the larger shapes; small sparks may have none. No characters, faces, hands, cards or scenery.
PALETTE: a gilded cathedral-castle: white marble, gold, royal blue, warm sunset light through stained glass. Keep every row in this world's colours, but give each row its own main shape and motion: they must not look alike.

THE EFFECTS, one per row, top row first (the names are only to explain the idea; never write them):
Row 1: BERSERKER'S RAGE (plays on the hero who played it): a red-gold flame aura spikes up around a center point in jagged pulses, each spike leaves a thin blue plate flake hanging in the air, then the flames die and the flakes drop away.
Row 2: BITTER BREATH (plays on the hero who played it): a cold grey breath cloud rolls out in a wide plume, scraps of burnt ash swept up inside it harden into a shimmering blue barrier haze, then the plume thins away.
Row 3: BLOOD FIRE (plays on the hero who played it): a single crimson flame flickers on a gold wick, a red drop falls from it and bursts into a low ring of fire racing outward, then the ring burns out into embers.
Row 4: BORROWED BLADE (plays on the hero who played it): a ghostly pale-blue sword outline drifts in from the side, fills with solid gold from hilt to tip in a bright flash, then its edges flake into ash as it hangs ready.

NEGATIVE: text, letters, numbers, runes that look like writing, captions, labels, UI, card frames, borders, grid lines, watermark, logo, photorealism, soft fog, characters, faces, hands, gore.
```
